an10.174:1.1: CLXXIV. Pāṇātipātaṃ p' ahaṃ bhikkhave tividhaṃ vadāmi: lobhahetukam pi dosahetukam pi mohahetukam pi.
an10.174:2.1: Adinnādānaṃ p' ahaṃ bhikkhave tividhaṃ vadāmi: lobhahetukam pi dosahetukam pi mohahetukam pi.
an10.174:3.1: Kāmesu micchācāraṃ p' ahaṃ bhikkhave tividhaṃ vadāmi: lobhahetukam pi dosahetukam pi mohahetukam pi.
an10.174:4.1: Musāvādaṃ p' ahaṃ bhikkhave tividhaṃ vadāmi: lobhahetukam pi dosahetukam pi mohahetukam pi.
an10.174:5.1: Pisunavācaṃ p' ahaṃ bhikkhave tividhaṃ vadāmi: lobhahetukam pi dosahetukam pi mohahetukam pi.
an10.174:6.1: Pharusavācaṃ p' ahaṃ bhikkhave tividhaṃ vadāmi: lobhahetukam pi dosahetukam pi mohahetukam pi.
an10.174:7.1: Samphappalāpaṃ p' ahaṃ bhikkhave tividhaṃ vadāmi: lobhahetukam pi dosahetukam pi mohahetukam pi.
an10.174:8.1: Abhijjhaṃ p' ahaṃ bhikkhave tividhaṃ vadāmi: lobhahetukam pi dosahetukam pi mohahetukam pi.
an10.174:9.1: Vyāpādaṃ p' ahaṃ bhikkhave tividhaṃ vadāmi: lobhahetukam pi dosahetukam pi mohahetukam pi.
an10.174:10.1: Micchādiṭṭhiṃ p' ahaṃ bhikkhave tividhaṃ vadāmi: lobhahetukam pi dosahetukam pi mohahetukam pi. Iti kho bhikkhave lobho kammanidānasambhavo doso kammanidānasambhavo moho kammanidānasambhavo, lobhakkhayā kammanidānasaṃkhayo dosakkhayā kammanidānasaṃkhayo mohakkhayā kammanidānasaṃkhayo ti.
